scene_analysis.scene_overview: A wide-angle view of a city street with tall buildings, trees, and a person sitting on a bench. The street is paved with gray concrete and has a few steps leading up to a sidewalk. There are several trees and bushes along the sidewalk, as well as a few benches and a bus stop. In the distance, there are several tall buildings, including a large white building with many windows and a smaller brown building with balconies. The sky is overcast.
